About SOXL

Fund Home Page

The Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X ETF (SOXL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NYSE Semiconductor index. The fund provides 3x daily exposure to a modified market-cap-weighted index of 30 US-listed semiconductor companies. SOXL was launched on Mar 11, 2010 and is issued by Direxion.
